title: WabbleSpec API/Service Platform Receipt
description: Extends base receipt schema for API/Service platform activation and gate verification.

framework.description: HTTP framework in use (fastify, express, fastapi, gin, axum, etc.)

spec_template_variant.description: Fixed: api-service — confirms API/Service templates were used, not generic

openapi_contract_present.description: true if openapi.yaml / schema.graphql / .proto file committed to repo

health_endpoint_declared.description: true if /health (or equivalent) declared in design-document and implemented

ready_endpoint_declared.description: true if /ready (or equivalent) declared in design-document and implemented

rate_limiting_declared.description: true if rate limiting strategy declared in design-document (even if 'none' with justification)

verification_gates_failed.description: Gate IDs that failed. Must be empty before Delivery wave.

auth_enforcement_verified.description: Gate 1 passed: unauthenticated request → 401 on all protected endpoints

secrets_in_logs_verified.description: Gate 4 passed: known token value absent from all log output

parameterized_queries_verified.description: Gate 7 passed: no user-input concatenation found in query strings

p99_latency_ms.description: Measured p99 response latency in milliseconds from load test

container_exit_code_on_sigterm.description: Gate 9: container exit code after SIGTERM. Must be 0.
